second.reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 (agent), blind second look at the four Ängsö ring sheets

angso-tee-01-1.reason: Years disagree: the 2025 photo shows a mown oval deck inside the ring, but the 2019 photo shows only tree crowns over the whole window and no deck.
angso-tee-01-1.resolution: Hole 1's new back tee (Vit, since the 2023 card): forest on 2019-07-14, felled on 2021-04-14, a mown deck with its own path on 2023-05-11 and 2025-04-24. The ring follows the 2025 deck. The terrain under it is the felled slope the laser saw in March 2021 (4.4%), which the walkthrough keeps as the ground's age.

angso-tee-01-2.reason: Years disagree: on the 2019 photo a long pale mown strip runs about 5 m west of the ring and the ring sits on plain turf, while on 2025 a narrow path runs there and the ring encloses a mown strip.
angso-tee-01-2.resolution: The long strip east of the path was built after 2019: the pale strip 5 m west on 2019-07-14 is the old mown edge beside the path, the strip is cut on 2021-04-14, and it is mown with the path beside it on 2023-05-11 and 2025-04-24. The ring follows that deck, and the terrain under it is level (deck-ground.mjs).

angso-tee-01-3.reason: Years disagree: mown deck inside the ring on 2025, bare square pad on 2019 (built between).
angso-tee-01-3.resolution: Rebuilt in the summer of 2019 (a bare deck on 2019-07-14) and mown on every photo since; the laser of 2021-03-20 measures the ground under the ring level (deck-ground.mjs), so the ring and the terrain both hold the rebuilt deck.

angso-tee-12-1.reason: Years disagree: on 2019 a path runs through the ring's north-west end while on 2025 the path curves past south-west of it, and no deck edge shows inside the ring on either photo.
angso-tee-12-1.fault: A path crosses the ring's north-west end on 2019-07-14 and runs past it on 2025-04-24, and the terrain under the ring slopes 11.1%: the ring takes in the path and the brook's bank as well as the deck. Redraw it on the deck east of the path from the 2025 photo at full scale (lm-review-back9-tees.json), rebuild, and measure it again with deck-ground.mjs.

angso-green-07.reason: Years disagree: on 2019 the pale putting surface fills only the southern part of the ring and its northern third is darker turf, while on 2025 long tree shadows hide the edge there, so the north end may take in fringe.
angso-green-07.resolution: On the spring photos (2023-05-11 and 2025-04-24) the putting surface is one even colour the length of the ring, its narrow north lobe included; on 2019-07-14 the north third is darker because a tree's shadow lies across it, not because it is fringe (render at 50 m, all four years).
